The Monetary and Banking Council of the Bank of Algeria authorised Djezzy Payment Services to constitute itself as a payment service provider under regulation 25-02, with a licence application due within twelve months.

Banking consultant Mostefa Zerouali says Bank of Algeria Regulation 25-02 sets the conditions for licensing payment service providers, that the Bank of Algeria is the licensing authority, and that none is yet licensed with several applications under examination.

The Conseil Monetaire et Bancaire, chaired by the Bank of Algeria governor, authorised Djezzy Payment Services to be constituted as a payment service provider on 23 September 2026, the first such authorisation; an operating licence from the Bank of Algeria is still to follow.

Ecofin Agency reports the Bank of Algeria authorized Djezzy Payment Services to incorporate as a payment service provider on 23 September 2026, with a licence still required before operating, under Regulation No. 25-02 of April 2025 setting incorporation, licensing and operating requirements.
